Resolve the Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger, causing you to create a Jace planeswalker token and put two loyalty counters on it.

Resolve the Jace token's ability, causing you to surveil 1.

Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Evereth by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.

1278-3327-4508-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.

Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.

Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.

Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.

When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

You have a land card in hand.

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.

Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.

When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.

Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.

Holding priority, if the land(s) enter the battlefield untapped, you may activate them by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, if applicable, either causing you to scry 1 or to tap or untap target creature.
Resolve the first Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Repeat from step 2.
If applicable, resolve all remaining Evolution Sage triggers, causing you to proliferate that many times.
If you sacrifice and return two lands each cycle, this combo will net infinite untap of creatures you control and infinite scry 1.
